title: StrategySpec
description: The ONE canonical, CLOSED, declarative strategy spec. CRITICAL SECURITY INVARIANT: there is NO free-form code field anywhere (no CustomPythonNode, no scripted escape hatch at launch). The agent proposes DATA we validate, never code we run. v2.0 ships parameterized primitives, not the operator-DAG. id/tenant_id are always server-stamped. additionalProperties:false everywhere enforces the closed schema.

id.description: Server-stamped strategy id. Ignored if supplied by the agent.

version.description: Server-stamped immutable version. Each accepted edit mints a new version.

tenant_id.description: Server-stamped. Ignored if supplied by the agent.

origin_session_id.description: The research session that produced this proposal (lineage).

seed.description: Determinism: seed + pure numpy + fixed asOf window => identical artifact hash. 'Reproduce this run' is free.

source.description: Data source group for the universe. Only 'prices' (price/technical) at launch — fundamental-factor universes need a PIT source.

id.description: A parameterized primitive: a pure (close_panel, params) -> per-symbol (score, selected) function (ported/extended from v1 engine/strategies.py). Cross-sectional weighting is then applied by 'construction'. The operator-DAG is a post-launch upgrade.

params.description: Primitive-specific parameters (e.g. lookback, top, threshold). Validated per-primitive by the registry.

gross.description: Target gross exposure (sum of |weights|). The risk gate re-checks sum|w| vs maxGross AFTER projection (closes the v1 311%-gross optimizer bug).

cost_bps.description: Explicit commissions/fees in basis points per unit of turnover.

slippage_bps.description: Expected market impact/slippage in basis points per unit of turnover. Added to cost_bps for all-in trading cost.
